title: Shared Mallworld dream experienced together... Has anyone else ever done this?
content: Has anyone else ever shared a dream, a Mallworld scenario, and awakened to finishing each other's sentences when discussing the dream? I've heard it's a phenomena, but I haven't ever spoken to anyone else who shared such an elaborate dream at the same time. We literally just went to sleep. I woke up crying. He woke up right after me. We both started describing the exact places, people and details of this horrific nightmare. It was multiple levels of what we believed were Hell with his deceased mother guiding us out and away from there
